KPI.label: KPI
KPI.description: One number, large - with its change and its trend.

value.description: The number shown - from the last row. Defaults to the first number column.

target.description: A goal from the query - shown as how far the value is from it.

GAUGE.label: Gauge
GAUGE.description: A value on an arc, against its target.

value.description: The value on the arc - from the last row. Defaults to the first number column.

target.description: The full arc, from the query. Without it, the Target prop.

thresholds.description: Colors by value, in order: the first is the base color, each next one applies from its value up - a number, a column of the row or a variable. On a gauge, the arc in bands of those colors.

BAR.label: Bar chart
BAR.description: Vertical bars - one group per category, one bar per series.

BAR_HORIZONTAL.label: Horizontal bar
BAR_HORIZONTAL.description: Horizontal bars - for long labels; order the query yourself.

LEADERBOARD.label: Leaderboard
LEADERBOARD.description: A ranked list with bars - order and LIMIT the query yourself.

value.description: The ranked value. Defaults to the first number column.

category.description: Each row's name. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

image.description: A file column (an image) shown as a thumbnail beside each row. Defaults to the first file column.

LINE.label: Line chart
LINE.description: One line per series, over time or categories - oldest first.

AREA.label: Area chart
AREA.description: Lines filled below - totals over time.

PIE.label: Pie chart
PIE.description: Each row a slice of the whole.

value.description: The slice sizes. Defaults to the first number column.

category.description: Each slice's name. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

DONUT.label: Donut chart
DONUT.description: A pie with a hole - each row a slice of the whole.

value.description: The slice sizes. Defaults to the first number column.

category.description: Each slice's name. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

MAP.label: Map
MAP.description: Points on a street map - from a point column, or latitude and longitude.

label.description: Shown on a point's tooltip. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

displayFormat.description: How the Size value reads in a point's tooltip. Unset: its column's format.

TABLE.label: Table
TABLE.description: The rows as they come - columns starting with _ never show.

colorColumn.description: A column whose value - a palette name - tints its row. Unset, a column named _color. _<column>_color shows that column as colored badges.

click.description: What a click on a row does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

TImage.description: A fixed image - a logo, a branch's floor plan: a file uploaded here (public) or an https URL.

THeading.description: A section title - a formula may name what is shown: "Sales of " + {'{'}{'{'}vars.seller.label{'}'}{'}'}.

TText.description: A paragraph - its text a formula over the variables, the viewer and the query's rows.

TQrCode.description: A QR code of a value - a link to this report, a device's code - drawn in the browser.

UBadge.description: A short label - its text and color may be formulas: a state, a count.

UAlert.description: A message with a title and a description - a warning the query or a variable decides.

USeparator.description: A rule between sections, with an optional label.

TFrame.description: Another site's page in a sandboxed frame - its URL may take {'{'}{'{'}vars.…{'}'}{'}'}, {'{'}{'{'}user.…{'}'}{'}'} and {'{'}{'{'}row.…{'}'}{'}'} values after the site.

PROGRESS.label: Progress
PROGRESS.description: A bar of a value toward its target - "$ 13.9M of $ 30M · 46 %", colored by thresholds.

value.description: The value - from the last row. Defaults to the first number column.

target.description: The goal, from the query. Without it, the Target prop.
The goal, when the query has no Target column.

thresholds.description: Colors by value, in order: the first is the base color, each next one applies from its value up - a number, a column of the row or a variable. On the value, or on the percent with Thresholds on: Percent. Wins over Color.

COMBO.label: Combo chart
COMBO.description: Bars and lines on two axes - the first value column as bars on the left, the rest as lines on the right.

values.description: Two or more columns: the first as bars (left axis), the rest as lines (right axis) - Series changes that.

WATERFALL.label: Waterfall
WATERFALL.description: How a total is built - each row a change up or down; a total row the running sum so far.

value.description: Each row's change, with its sign. Defaults to the first number column.

FUNNEL.label: Funnel
FUNNEL.description: Steps in the query's order, each with its share of the first or the previous step.

category.description: Each step's name - in the query's order. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

value.description: Each step's value - never negative. Defaults to the first number column.

TREEMAP.label: Treemap
TREEMAP.description: Nested rectangles by levels (branch → category → product), each sized by its value; a parent is the sum of its children.

value.description: A leaf's value - summable (never an average), never negative. Defaults to the first number column.

SUNBURST.label: Sunburst
SUNBURST.description: Rings by levels, the innermost the first; a parent is the sum of its children.

levels.description: The hierarchy, innermost ring first - every column that isn't a number by default. A NULL ends its branch there.

value.description: A leaf's value - summable (never an average), never negative. Defaults to the first number column.

HEATMAP.label: Heatmap
HEATMAP.description: A grid of two categories (day × hour, branch × month), each cell colored by its value; a missing cell stays empty.

value.description: Each cell's value. Defaults to the first number column.

color.description: The scale's hue, from the background to it - unset, the theme's primary. Thresholds draw fixed bands instead.

thresholds.description: Colors by value, in order: the first is the base color, each next one applies from its value up - a number, a column of the row or a variable. On a heatmap, bands of those colors with their legend.

click.description: What a click on a cell does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

CALENDAR.label: Calendar heatmap
CALENDAR.description: Every day of a year colored by its value - a year per row, the latest three.

value.description: Each day's value. Defaults to the first number column.

color.description: The scale's hue, from the background to it - unset, the theme's primary. Thresholds draw fixed bands instead.

thresholds.description: Colors by value, in order: the first is the base color, each next one applies from its value up - a number, a column of the row or a variable. On a calendar, bands of those colors with their legend.

click.description: What a click on a day does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

SCATTER.label: Scatter and bubbles
SCATTER.description: Points by two numbers - with Size, bubbles; with Group, a series per group.

x.description: Defaults to the first number column; a date chosen by hand.

y.description: Defaults to the next number column.

size.description: Each point's size (radius by its square root, 6 to 40 px) - bubbles. Optional.

label.description: Each point's name in its tooltip. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

series.description: Per Group value: its name and color. Unset: the Group column's presentation (its labels and colors).

axes.description: The x and y axes' title, range, scale and format. Unset minimum: fitted to the data.

references.description: Lines and bands - a line on the y axis (or the x one), at a number, a statistic, a column or a variable.

click.description: What a click on a point does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

zoom.description: Bars under and beside the chart, and the wheel or a pinch, to zoom into a range of x and y.

DETAIL.label: Detail
DETAIL.description: One row as label / value pairs, with its image - the query's first row.

columns.description: The fields shown, in this order. Defaults to every column (but _ ones).

image.description: A file column shown as its image, above (or beside, with layout Two). Defaults to the first file column.

columnSettings.label: Field settings
columnSettings.description: Per field: its title, format, text when empty, look - over what its presentation says.

click.description: What a click on the card does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

PIVOT.label: Pivot table
PIVOT.description: The query's detail rows aggregated by PostgreSQL into rows × columns, with subtotals and totals - never added up on screen.

columns.description: Levels across the top (at most 60 values). Optional.

values.description: What is aggregated - each with its aggregate. Defaults to every number column.

columnSettings.label: Value settings
columnSettings.description: Per value or row column: its title, format, text when empty - over what its presentation says.

click.description: What a click on a detail cell (not a total) does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

category.label: Category
category.description: The axis labels - a date makes a time axis. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

values.label: Values
values.description: One series per column, in this order. Defaults to every number column.

series.label: Series
series.description: Long format: one series per value of this column (`month, seller, total`) - with one value column. Optional.

label.label: Label
label.description: Each row's name. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

value.label: Value
value.description: The number shown - from the last row. Defaults to the first number column.

compare.label: Comparison
compare.description: The value it compares with, from the same row (e.g. last month's). Without it, the previous row's value.

time.label: Time
time.description: With it, the rows are a series, oldest first: the last is the value, the rest its trend.

target.label: Target
target.description: A goal from the query - shown as how far the value is from it.

location.label: Location
location.description: A point column (x = longitude, y = latitude). Defaults to the first point column.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.description: Only without a point column - chosen by hand, with Longitude.

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.description: Only without a point column - chosen by hand, with Latitude.

size.label: Size
size.description: Scales each point by this value. Optional.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: The columns shown, in this order. Defaults to every column (but _ ones).

tooltip.label: Tooltip
tooltip.description: More columns shown in a mark's tooltip, with their titles and formats. Optional.

total.label: Total
total.description: Chosen by hand: a true/false column - a true row draws the running total so far from 0 (its value is ignored).

levels.label: Levels
levels.description: The hierarchy, outermost first - every column that isn't a number by default. A NULL ends its branch there.

x.label: X
x.description: The columns - in the query's order (a date sorted). Defaults to the first column that isn't a number; a number (an hour) only by hand.

y.label: Y
y.description: The rows - in the query's order (a date sorted). Defaults to the next column that isn't a number; a number (a weekday) only by hand.

group.label: Group
group.description: A series per value of this column, colored by its presentation. Optional.

date.label: Date
date.description: The day. Defaults to the first date column.

image.label: Image
image.description: A file column shown as its image. Defaults to the first file column.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: One or more levels down the side, outermost first. Defaults to the first column that isn't a number.

color.label: Color
color.description: A palette hue for its marks - unset, the theme's primary.

showLegend.label: Show legend
showLegend.description: The series' (or slices') names, beside the chart.

compact.label: Compact number
compact.description: Abbreviates large numbers - 11.6M, 2.4K - keeping the format's text and decimals ("$ #,##0" + compact: $ 1.3M). Unset: on, unless a format applies.

colorColumn.label: Color column
colorColumn.description: A column whose value - a palette name: red, emerald, amber... - colors its row's mark. Unset, a column named _color, if the query returns one.

stacked.label: Stacked
stacked.description: Stacks the series instead of placing them side by side.

showDelta.label: Show change
showDelta.description: Percent change vs. the comparison, green up / red down.

sparkline.label: Show trend
sparkline.description: A small line of the value across the rows (order them by time).

lowerIsBetter.label: Lower is better
lowerIsBetter.description: Flips the change's colors - for costs or response times.

target.label: Target
target.description: The value the full arc stands for, when the query has no Target column.

cluster.label: Group nearby points
cluster.description: Joins points close together into a numbered circle.

columnSettings.label: Column settings
columnSettings.description: Per column: its title, alignment, format, look and total - over what its presentation says.

displayFormat.label: Format
displayFormat.description: How its numbers read - a pattern such as "$ #,##0", "0.0 %" (% never multiplies: 85 reads 85.0 %) or "CURRENCY:ARS". Unset: the value column's own format, else the viewer's language.

series.label: Series
series.description: Per value column - or, in long format, per value of the Series column: its name, color, type, axis and format. Unset: inherited.

axes.label: Axes
axes.description: Each axis' title, range, scale and format. The right axis shows once a series uses it.

thresholds.label: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Colors by value, in order: the first is the base color, each next one applies from its value up - a number, a column of the row or a variable. Wins over Color.

references.label: Reference lines
references.description: Lines and bands on the value axis - at a number, a statistic of the series, a column or a variable. Their labels read in the axis' format.

click.label: On click
click.description: What a click on a mark does. Its values are formulas over the clicked row and the variables.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.description: A bar under the chart, and the wheel or a pinch, to zoom into a range.

showPercent.label: Show percent
showPercent.description: The share of the target reached - past it, its real value (115 %).

thresholdsOn.label: Thresholds on
thresholdsOn.description: Value: the thresholds read the value; Percent: the percent of the target (60 = 60 %).

finalTotal.label: Final total
finalTotal.description: A last bar with the running total.

increaseColor.label: Increase color
increaseColor.description: A palette hue for a change up.

decreaseColor.label: Decrease color
decreaseColor.description: A palette hue for a change down.

totalColor.label: Total color
totalColor.description: A palette hue for a total - unset, the theme's primary.

sort.label: Order
sort.description: The query's order, or the largest first.

conversion.label: Conversion
conversion.description: Each step's percent of the first step, of the previous one, or none.

visibleLevels.label: Levels shown
visibleLevels.description: How many levels at once - a tap goes down one, the breadcrumb back.

showValues.label: Show values
showValues.description: Each cell's number written in it.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: Automatic: two columns from 6 wide, one on a phone; or always one or two.

aggregates.label: Aggregates
aggregates.description: Required for each value: sum, average, minimum, maximum or count, computed by PostgreSQL over the detail rows - an average is the real one, never an average of averages.

subtotals.label: Subtotals
subtotals.description: A subtotal for each level of the rows.

rowTotals.label: Row totals
rowTotals.description: A total column at the right.

columnTotals.label: Column totals
columnTotals.description: A total row at the bottom.

sortBy.label: Sort rows by
sortBy.description: A value's total, ascending or descending. Unset: by the rows' own values.

SELECT.label: Select
SELECT.description: One option (text) or several (text[] - use = ANY(...)).

createModal.title: New Dashboard
createModal.description: Name it and give it a slug - widgets come next.

fromTable.title: New Dashboard from a table
fromTable.description: Reads a table or view and proposes a dashboard - you choose what goes in.
fromTable.tableOrViewHelp: Read from its definition, constraints and statistics - never its rows.
fromTable.nameHelp: Up to {max} characters. The slug comes from it.
fromTable.widgetsHelp: The proposed ones are ticked; the rest can be added.
fromTable.variablesHelp: Filters the viewer picks - change them in the editor afterwards.
fromTable.generateHelp: Creates an unpublished draft: every widget's SQL stays visible and editable in the editor.
fromTable.specInvalid: The dashboard could not be created: {n} problem | The dashboard could not be created: {n} problems

detailsModal.title: Dashboard details
detailsModal.autoRefreshHelp: How often the App re-runs every widget while the page is open and its tab visible. Applies at once, without publishing; the editor doesn't auto-refresh.
detailsModal.visibleToRolesHelp: Who can view this dashboard in the App once it's published. Administrators always can. Leave empty for administrators only.

widgetDrawer.queryDescription: SQL runs read-only. Ctrl+Enter to run. Use $VAR.<name> for the dashboard's variables and $USER.<column> for the viewer.
widgetDrawer.runToPreview: Run the query to preview the widget.
widgetDrawer.runsOnItsOwn: Runs on its own - no table needed.
widgetDrawer.optionalFilterHelp: A condition that applies only while the variable has a value - standard SQL, written at the cursor.
widgetDrawer.columnHelp: A column of your query, or an expression ({example}).
widgetDrawer.presentationDescription: Read-only SQL, optional: its formulas read the first row as {'{'}{'{'}row.<column>{'}'}{'}'} and every row as {'{'}{'{'}rows{'}'}{'}'}, beside {'{'}{'{'}vars.<name>{'}'}{'}'} and {'{'}{'{'}user.<field>{'}'}{'}'}.
widgetDrawer.detailFirstRow: Detail shows the first of {count} rows.

variablesModal.queryHelp: First column = value, optional second = label. May use $USER.* and other variables ($VAR.country) - its options then follow them.
variablesModal.title: Variables
variablesModal.description: Filters viewers pick in the bar above the canvas. Reference them in widget SQL as $VAR.<name>.
variablesModal.valuesHelp: Each option: its value (what the query compares) and, optionally, what the viewer reads - true / Yes. Unset is All.
variablesModal.optionsQueryHelp: Runs read-only, like a widget query.
variablesModal.defaultHelp: Used until the viewer picks a value.
variablesModal.fromTableHelp: A table's rows: its key the value, its row presentation the label - no SQL.
variablesModal.tableHelp: Each row an option - its key the value, its row presentation (Database) the label.
variablesModal.filtersHelp: A column of the table equal to another variable's value - the cities of the selected country. No value, no filter.
variablesModal.userFieldHelp: A column of the viewer's user row - their branch, their region. Without one (an embed), no value.

view.notAvailableHelp: It doesn't exist, isn't published, or you don't have access to it.
view.noWidgets: This dashboard has no widgets yet.

tabs.label: Name
tabs.firstHelp: Every widget already on the canvas goes on this first tab.
tabs.removeHolds: It holds a widget - it moves to the tab you choose. | It holds {count} widgets - they move to the tab you choose.
tabs.lastTab: It is the last tab: its widgets stay, in one grid without tabs.

widgetCard.exportTruncated: Only the first {count} rows were downloaded - the result was cut short.
widgetCard.truncatedHint: The query returned more - filter or aggregate it to see everything.
widgetCard.slow: Slow query - over {seconds} s. For a large table, a materialized view refreshed on a schedule helps (see the dashboards guide).

widgetView.noLocations: No rows with a valid location - return a point column (or lat/lng columns) and map it in the widget's properties.
widgetView.failed: This widget couldn't load its data.
widgetView.timeout: It took too long - try a shorter period, or ask the author to speed it up.

tapHint.dataview: Tap again to see the records
tapHint.dashboard: Tap again to open the dashboard
tapHint.record: Tap again to open the record

widgetView.fileBlocked: Image not available on this link
widgetView.detailFirstRow: Detail shows the first of {count} rows

embedDrawer.allowFilesHelp: Images and files the queries return that aren't public (a photo) - off: "Image not available on this link".
embedDrawer.allowFilesLinkWarning: Anyone with this link will see those images - a person's photo, for one. Turn it on only if that's intended.
embedDrawer.allowFilesWarning: Whoever the portal shows this embed to will see those images. Turn it on only if that's intended.
embedDrawer.allowExportHelp: Each widget's ⋮ offers CSV, Excel and an image. Only a convenience: whatever its queries return is already in the visitor's browser - in a public link, public.
embedDrawer.clicksNotHere: A click doesn't run here on: {widgets} - an embed runs only a filter on a variable its visitor changes, and a link marked "also in embeds".

modes.editableHelp: In the bar - the visitor chooses.
modes.hiddenHelp: Not in the bar - its default or the value below. Not a restriction.
modes.lockedHelp: Fixed by the embed - the visitor can never change it.

kinds.linkHelp: Paste it in a page - anyone with the URL sees it. For data that may be public.
kinds.signedHelp: Your portal's backend signs a token per visit - for private or per-customer data.

embedDrawer.copyFailed: Could not copy - select it and copy it by hand
embedDrawer.title: Share · {name}
embedDrawer.description: Show the published dashboard on another site - a public link or a signed embed for a portal.
embedDrawer.allowEmbeddingHelp: Off, none of its embeds shows anything. Embeds show the published version - a publish updates them all.
embedDrawer.unpublishedHelp: Embeds and this preview show the published version.
embedDrawer.noOriginsTitle: No site may frame an embed yet
embedDrawer.noOriginsHelp: Add the sites in Settings › Dashboards › Embedding. The preview here works anyway.
embedDrawer.linkToPaste: Link to paste in the page
embedDrawer.urlToFrame: URL to frame - your backend puts the signed token after the #
embedDrawer.nameHelp: To tell embeds apart - e.g. Website, Customer portal.
embedDrawer.variablesHelp: The value as in the App's URL: a preset or {example} for a period, commas for several. Only Locked restricts data.
embedDrawer.variablesHelpSigned: The value as in the App's URL: a preset or {example} for a period, commas for several. Only Locked restricts data - a Locked one left empty is given by the token.
embedDrawer.lockedMissing: A public link needs a value for {names}.
embedDrawer.originsHelp: Empty: every site in Settings › Dashboards › Embedding.
embedDrawer.linkPublicHelp: A public link is public to anyone who has its URL - it's in the page's HTML and opens outside the frame too. The sites above only decide who may frame it.
embedDrawer.secretMissing: Signed embeds need the embedding secret (Settings › Dashboards › Embedding).
embedDrawer.locksMissing: It locks {names}, no longer in the dashboard - it shows nothing until it's updated.
embedDrawer.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? It stops at once, for good.
embedDrawer.notPublishedHelp: An embed shows the published version - publish the dashboard first.
embedDrawer.showsHelp: The whole dashboard, or one of its published widgets alone, filling the frame the other site gives it.
embedDrawer.widgetMissing: The widget it shows is no longer in the dashboard - it shows nothing until it's updated.

editor.restoredHelp: Nothing is published yet - publish to make it live.
editor.copyCreatedHelp: An unpublished copy - publish it when ready.
editor.publishHelp: Makes the current widget layout the version viewers see in the App.
editor.unconfigured: {n} widgets are not configured and won't be shown in the App. | {n} widget is not configured and won't be shown in the App. | {n} widgets are not configured and won't be shown in the App.
editor.brokenEmbeds: Stops the embed {names}: it locks {variables}, no longer in the dashboard. Update it in Share. | Stops {n} embeds {names}: they lock {variables}, no longer in the dashboard. Update them in Share.
editor.largerScreen: Moving and resizing widgets needs a larger screen.
editor.devicePreview: {device} preview - switch to Desktop to move and resize widgets.
editor.emptyCompact: Add a widget from the ⋮ menu.
editor.empty: Pick a widget from the sidebar to add it to the canvas.
editor.deleteHelp: {name}, its widgets and every version are removed. This can't be undone.
editor.deleteWidgetHelp: {name} and its query leave the draft - publish to take it off the live dashboard.
editor.brokenWidgetEmbeds: Stops the embed {names}: the widget it shows is no longer in the dashboard. Update it in Share. | Stops {n} embeds {names}: the widget each shows is no longer in the dashboard. Update them in Share.

tree.notInMenuHelp: Not in the App menu - embedded in other forms only
tree.brokenWidgets: A widget's query names what is gone: {widgets} | {count} widgets' queries name what is gone: {widgets}

index.title: Select a Dashboard
index.description: Choose a Dashboard from the sidebar, or create a new one.
index.blankDescription: An empty draft - add its widgets and variables yourself.
index.fromTableDescription: Pick a table or view: it proposes the widgets, variables and filters - you choose what goes in.

widget.pick: Pick its Dashboard in the inspector.
widget.viewerPicks: Its variables are the viewer's to pick.

inspector.typeHelp: The types that fit what the query returns - the others greyed, with why. Switching keeps the equivalent columns.
inspector.title: Title
inspector.titleHelp: Shown at the top of the widget. Leave it empty for no title.
inspector.runToListColumns: Run the query to list its columns.
inspector.noAutomatic: No column of a kind it takes - choose one.
inspector.wrongKind: Not a kind of column this takes.

card.descriptionHelp: Shown by an ⓘ next to the title.
card.emptyTextHelp: Default: "No data for this period" when the query reads a date range, else "No data".
card.mobileHelp: Automatic: half for a small widget (a KPI), else the whole width.

series.empty: Run the query to list its series.
series.emptyLong: No series value yet - add one below, or run the query.
series.addValueHelp: In long format each value of the Series column is a series - type one to set its name, color or type.

axes.title: Title
axes.logHelp: For values spanning several orders of magnitude.

thresholds.base: Base color - below the first threshold.

worksIn.embeds: Works in the App and in embeds.

click.variableHelp: A variable of this dashboard - in an embed, only one the visitor may change.
click.noFilterVariables: This dashboard has no Select, Text or Number variable - add one in Variables.
click.formulaHelp: A formula - {row} reads the clicked row ({columns}), {vars} a variable ({variables}).
click.filterHelp: Optional - a JSON object in the Data API's where grammar, its values formulas: {example}
click.filterInvalid: Not a JSON object - it is kept as typed until it is one.
click.urlHelp: Its site written out (https://...), then {row} and {vars} after it - encoded.
click.inEmbedsHelp: Runs in a public link or a signed embed too.
click.hintHelp: The tooltip's last line - what a click does.

total.label: Total
total.help: A footer row, computed by PostgreSQL over every row the query returns, in the column's format.

problems.DASHBOARD_COMBO_NEEDS_TWO_VALUES: A combo chart needs at least two columns in Values - for a series per value of a column, use a Bar chart.

aggregates.empty: Run the query to list its values.
aggregates.required: Choose its aggregate - each value needs one.

settings.appliesAtOnce: Changes on this tab apply at once - no Publish needed.
settings.appliesOnPublish: Variables are versioned: a change reaches the App on the next Publish.
